"""tally: counts the words of a file."""
import sys


def main(argv):
    with open(argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as f:
        print(len(f.read().split(" ")))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv)

"""tally: counts the words of a file."""
import sys


def main(argv):
    with open(argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as f:
        print(len(f.read().split()), argv[1])
